title: A short history of the Velmora Basin Water Authority
snippet: Founded in 1987, the authority took over the basin's three reservoirs.
body: The Velmora Basin Water Authority was founded in 1987 after the regional council merged three reservoir boards. Its first chair, Oriel Tamsin, oversaw the transfer of assets.
author: Hesper Quill
